evidence.quote: For 2025-12-31, bdc_investment_identifier LIKE 'Affiliated Issuer |%' selects 10 holdings rows totaling fair_value 23,078,000.

Examples in staging show paired rows: 'Affiliated Issuer | Discover Financial Services, ABF Equity' fair_value 1,372,000 and 'Discover Financial Services, ABF Equity | Financial Services' fair_value 1,372,000; 'Affiliated Issuer | KSC I Aircraft LP, ABF Equity' fair_value 12,152,000 and 'KSC I Aircraft LP, ABF Equity | Capital Goods' fair_value 12,152,000.

rationale: Rows prefixed 'Affiliated Issuer |' are duplicate axis representations of real investments already present under their portfolio company and industry identifiers. Counting both overstates fair value.
